mechanism.summary: A fake parcel-redelivery page: a tiny fee is the pretext, and the payment step asks for the card PIN and the one-time code from the bank. No delivery company asks for a card PIN or a bank one-time code; this is card phishing. A reason that only mentions the fee or the deadline does not count.

blocks.text: To confirm the card holder, enter the card PIN and the one-time code your bank sends you on the next screen.
Card holder check: your card PIN and the one-time code from your bank are required to release the parcel.
Thank you. Your redelivery is booked (reference {ref}).
